## Purpose

Detect edits between planning and execution.

## When a playbook uses it

Immediately before using a recorded proposal to launch validation.

## How it works internally

The handler verifies record visibility, then the service recomputes the complete snapshot fingerprint against the recorded workspace and base. See [`test_selection_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/test_selection_commands.py) and [`service.py`](../../../src/test_selection/service.py).

## Side effects and persistence

Reads the immutable selection and git state; writes no test success or observation.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

`not_found` means the selection is absent. `out_of_scope` means it is not attached to the session’s held task. `stale: true` requires a new proposal before execution.

Command-step payload (promotion/revocation examples require a local operator context):
